blocks.text: Har cloud deployment model ke apne faide aur nuqsanaat hain; kaunsa behtar hai, yeh idare ki khaas zarooraton aur maqasid (goals) par munhasir hai.

items: Muwazna (Comparison): public clouds saste hain lekin kam mehfooz. Private clouds zyada mehfooz hain lekin mehngi. Hybrid clouds lachak (flexibility) deti hain, jabke multi-clouds resilience (mushkil mein bhi chalte rehne ki salahiyat) deti hain.

blocks.caption: Deployment models ka muwazna (kitab ki line table ki shakal mein)
rows: resilience: ek provider ruke to doosre chalte rehte hain

blocks.prompt: Kam paise aur baghair hassas data wala ek chhota start-up kaunsa model chune?
blocks.explanation: Public cloud, kyunke yeh sab se sasta hai aur foran shuru ho sakta hai; hassas data na hone ki wajah se zyada security ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Public sasta magar kam mehfooz; private mehfooz magar mehnga.
